visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with two men sitting at a gray table in an indoor studio. The man on the right (Ian) wears a black t-shirt and gestures with his hands toward the guest on the left (ØZI), who wears a plaid shirt and glasses. The background features shelving with various snack packages and a wall with the logo 'THE DODO MEN'. (2) A transition occurs to a close-up of ØZI holding a blue can and flashing a peace sign. He then looks down at a white paper on the table, his mouth moving rapidly as if reciting something. (3) The camera shifts to Ian, who is looking at a smartphone acting as a timer, then back to ØZI, who is laughing with his eyes closed and hands on his head. (4) Ian takes a turn, leaning over the paper with a focused expression, his hands waving in rhythm with his mouth movements, eventually leading to a wide grin and laughter. (5) The shot changes to the second round where Ian reads a new paper; he looks frustrated, touching his forehead. (6) ØZI attempts the same paper, his head bobbing as he speaks, ending in a jubilant celebration where both men raise their hands and cheer. (7) A third round begins focusing on the Taiwanese challenge. Ian points at the paper, looking confused and hesitant. ØZI then tries, gesturing emphatically with one hand while the other rests on the table. (8) The video concludes with both men facing the camera, smiling and clapping their hands together. Red Bull cans are visible on the table throughout.
